svg.title: Daily GPP pulse (mean of days 0 to 2 minus the pre-pulse mean) against the soil water content anomaly before the rain, one marker per 5 mm event.
svg.desc: Six panels, one per site. X axis: soil water content (SWC) of the day before the rain minus the site median of the season, in m3 m-3. Y axis: pulse = mean of days 0 to 2 of daily GPP, minus the pre-pulse mean, in µmol CO2 m-2 s-1. One marker per event with at least 5 mm of rain; line = ordinary least squares (OLS) fit. Per site: Anttila: Pearson r = −0.30 (p = 0.400), Spearman ρ = −0.47 (p = 0.174), slope −11.2 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 10. Särkisuo: Pearson r = −0.25 (p = 0.520), Spearman ρ = −0.05 (p = 0.898), slope −3.7 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 9. Haltiala (Viikki rain): Pearson r = 0.15 (p = 0.700), Spearman ρ = 0.42 (p = 0.262), slope 6.2 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 9. Qvidja: Pearson r = −0.06 (p = 0.843), Spearman ρ = −0.03 (p = 0.931), slope −4.1 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 12. Viikki: Pearson r = 0.38 (p = 0.396), Spearman ρ = 0.18 (p = 0.702), slope 16.4 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 7. Maktau: Pearson r = 0.56 (p = 0.002), Spearman ρ = 0.66 (p = < 0.001), slope 12.4 µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 per m3 m-3, n = 29.
